title: cn: a drop-in replacement for clsx plus tailwind-merge with zero dependencies
description:
Tailwind class conflicts usually mean combining clsx with tailwind-merge. cn replaces both through the same familiar APIs, so existing projects can migrate without rewriting every component. It has zero dependencies, works across frameworks and runtimes, and supports custom Tailwind configurations. The maintainers report a 30-times speedup for common component calls, backed by reproducible benchmarks.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/shadcn-ui/cn
